title: Design versioned odd-byte GF16 tail profile
description: The current GF16 symbol/wire representation cannot provide a universal fixed-B-byte MDS contract for odd B; commit d748620 documents the counterexample and safely supports every positive even length. Define the explicit new mathematics/API/wire identity needed for odd byte tails, comparing padded wire storage, GF8-hybrid final-byte coding, and paired-stripe semantics. Implement the selected versioned profile or revise the public contract with a proof-backed limitation. Never silently change legacy_high_v1 or low_v1.
design: Select LEO2_SHARD_LAYOUT_GF16_PADDED_ODD_V1. For odd application payload B, every systematic and parity coordinate physically stores W=B+1 bytes. Systematic packing is payload||0; parity byte W-1 is generally nonzero and must be transmitted. Core arithmetic remains the existing compact even-byte GF16 V1 at W bytes, so high/low profile, coordinate map, field representation, codec coefficients, and plan locators do not change. The layout is explicit codec identity and never AUTO-selected. Existing native/even behavior stays byte-identical. Reject hybrid as a general solution because its GF8 component is MDS only in a GF8-limited coordinate region; keep paired stripes experimental because they change recovery to K jointly received pairs.
acceptance_criteria: A source-backed design selects or rejects each candidate; serialized profile/field identity and exact shard-storage semantics are specified; direct algebra proves systematic/MDS behavior for the selected construction; byte sizes 1..65 and 1023..1025 pass direct differential, guards, ASan and UBSan under the new identifier; legacy/even-byte outputs remain bit-identical; migration and incompatibility are documented.
notes:
2026-07-16 research disposition: padded physical storage is the only small construction preserving the single-codeword any-K-coordinate contract for every GF16-legal K,R. Hybrid adds no current AUTO coverage and cannot exceed a proven GF8 count bound; paired stripes require identical/joint erasure semantics. Implement as a framing layout around existing even-byte GF16 with payload-to-wire query and allocation-free pack/unpack, plus identity/mismatch and direct-oracle tests. Claim is intentionally active despite the inherited public-API blocker because the isolated versioned framing work can proceed; final API freezing remains gated on leopard-79h.10.
Closure evidence commit db8b6fa: explicit fixed-width GF16_PADDED_ODD_V1 layout, B-to-W=B+1 query, overlap-safe allocation-free systematic pack/unpack, critical fail-closed L2ID identity, and native/even compatibility docs.
